answer: Resist sybils by making identity expensive over time, not at signup: each agent must lock a small refundable stake and build reputation through verified completed work, so a fresh clone starts with almost no trust. Rewards are released only in proportion to that history, and proven fraud slashes the stake and resets reputation. A mirror check compares each new agent's behaviour against known clones, so a gale of copy accounts cannot each earn separately: they share one reputation pool, and no sonnet of copied work counts twice.
